title: Connecting to the corporate VPN
text: Kaveri Systems uses the KaveriConnect VPN client. Open KaveriConnect, choose the 'India-South' gateway and sign in with your company email and MFA code. If the client shows error 809, your home router is blocking the VPN port: switch the gateway to 'India-South-443', which works on most networks.

title: Resetting a forgotten password
text: Go to https://reset.kaverisystems.example and verify with your registered mobile number. Passwords must be at least 14 characters and cannot reuse any of your last 5 passwords. After a reset, sign out of Outlook and Teams on your phone, or your account will lock after 10 failed sync attempts.

title: Account locked out
text: Accounts lock for 30 minutes after 10 failed sign-in attempts. Wait 30 minutes or call the IT helpdesk on extension 4357 (HELP) to unlock immediately. Repeated lockouts are usually caused by an old password saved on a phone or tablet.

title: Setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA)
text: MFA is mandatory for all employees. Install Microsoft Authenticator, then open https://aka.ms/mfasetup on your laptop and scan the QR code. If you change phones, ask the helpdesk to reset your MFA registration before you wipe the old phone.

title: Laptop refresh policy
text: Employee laptops are replaced every 3 years, or earlier if the repair cost exceeds 40% of a new device. Engineers can request 32 GB of RAM with manager approval. Return your old laptop to IT within 10 working days of receiving the new one.

title: Requesting a GitHub Copilot licence
text: Raise a 'Developer Tools' request in the service portal and choose GitHub Copilot Business. Your manager approves it and the licence is assigned to your company GitHub account within one working day. Copilot must only be used with company repositories while signed in with your company account.

title: Office Wi-Fi networks
text: Use 'Kaveri-Corp' for company laptops; it signs you in automatically with your certificate. Visitors use 'Kaveri-Guest', with a daily password shown at reception. Personal phones must not join Kaveri-Corp.

title: Printing in the Mysuru office
text: Printers on every floor use secure release printing. Send your job to 'Kaveri-SecurePrint', then tap your ID card on any printer to release it. Unreleased jobs are deleted after 24 hours.

title: Installing software
text: Approved software is available in the Company Portal app without admin rights. Software not in the portal needs a security review, which takes about 5 working days. Never install browser extensions that ask to read data on all websites.

title: Reporting a phishing email
text: Use the 'Report Phishing' button in Outlook. Do not forward the email to colleagues. If you clicked a link or entered your password, reset your password immediately and call the security team on extension 7777.

title: Storing and sharing files
text: Store work files in OneDrive or SharePoint, never on USB drives. External sharing links expire after 30 days. Files labelled 'Confidential' cannot be shared outside the company.

title: Using generative AI tools at work
text: Approved AI tools are GitHub Copilot Business and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Do not paste customer data, source code or personal data into public chatbots. AI-generated code must be reviewed by a human before it is merged.

title: Annual leave entitlement
text: Full-time employees get 21 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued monthly. Up to 10 unused days carry over to the next year; the rest lapse on 31 March. Apply for leave in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance for absences longer than 2 days.

title: Sick leave
text: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days. Sick leave does not carry over.

title: Work from home policy
text: Employees can work from home up to 2 days per week with their manager's agreement. Tuesdays and Thursdays are team office days. The company reimburses up to INR 1,000 per month for home internet.

title: Parental leave
text: Birth mothers receive 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Other parents, including adoptive parents, receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave, to be taken within 6 months of the birth or adoption.

title: Notice period and resignation
text: The notice period is 60 days for employees in their first 2 years and 90 days after that. Submit your resignation in the HR portal. Unused annual leave can be adjusted against the notice period with manager approval.

title: Learning and certification budget
text: Each employee has a learning budget of INR 40,000 per financial year for courses and certification exams. Exam fees are reimbursed only for passed exams. Submit the receipt and certificate within 30 days.

title: Employee referral bonus
text: Refer candidates through the careers portal. If your referral joins and completes 90 days, you receive a bonus of INR 50,000 for engineering roles and INR 25,000 for other roles.

title: Health insurance
text: Employees, their spouse and up to two children are covered by group health insurance up to INR 5 lakh per year. Parents can be added for an extra premium deducted from salary. Cashless treatment is available at network hospitals, including JSS Hospital in Mysuru.

title: Domestic travel reimbursement
text: For domestic business travel, economy flights or AC 2-tier train tickets are reimbursed. Hotel limits are INR 7,000 per night in metro cities and INR 4,500 per night in other cities. The daily meal allowance is INR 1,200 in metros and INR 800 elsewhere.

title: International travel
text: International travel needs approval from a director at least 21 days before departure. Economy class is standard; business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8 hours. The daily allowance for international trips is USD 75.

title: Submitting expense claims
text: Submit expense claims in the Finance portal within 30 days of the expense, with a photo of every receipt above INR 500. Claims are approved by your manager and paid with the next salary. Claims older than 90 days are rejected.

title: Corporate credit card
text: Employees who travel more than 4 times a year can apply for a corporate card. Personal spending on the corporate card is not allowed. Lost cards must be reported to Finance within 24 hours.

title: Client entertainment
text: Client meals are reimbursed up to INR 2,500 per person. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Record the client company and attendees on the claim.

title: Salary and payslips
text: Salary is paid on the last working day of each month. Payslips are available in the HR portal from the 1st of the following month. Investment declarations for tax must be submitted by 15 January.

title: Booking meeting rooms
text: Book meeting rooms through Outlook by adding the room as an attendee. Bookings are released automatically if nobody checks in on the room panel within 10 minutes. The Chamundi boardroom requires approval from the office manager.

title: Office hours and access
text: The Mysuru office is open 7:00 to 22:00 on weekdays. Weekend access requires prior approval from facilities. Always tap your own ID card; tailgating through the gates is a security violation.

title: Cafeteria
text: The cafeteria on the ground floor serves breakfast from 8:00 to 10:00 and lunch from 12:30 to 14:30. Meals are subsidised; the employee pays INR 60 for lunch. Filter coffee is free all day.

title: Parking
text: Two-wheeler parking is free in basement B1. Car parking in B2 is allocated by monthly lottery. Electric vehicle chargers are available at bays 1 to 6 for a maximum of 3 hours per car.

title: Lost and found
text: Hand found items to reception on the ground floor. Items are kept for 30 days before being donated. Lost ID cards must be reported to security immediately, and a replacement costs INR 300.

title: Clean desk policy
text: Lock your screen (Windows+L) whenever you leave your desk. At the end of the day, store papers in your locked pedestal. Confidential printouts go in the blue shred bins.

title: Handling personal data
text: Personal data such as names, phone numbers and Aadhaar numbers must only be stored in approved systems. Never email Aadhaar or PAN numbers. Report any suspected data breach to the privacy team within 1 hour of discovering it.

title: Secrets in source code
text: Never commit passwords, API keys or tokens to Git. Use Azure Key Vault or environment variables instead. If a secret is committed, rotate it immediately: deleting the commit is not enough, because the secret stays in the Git history.

title: Travelling with a laptop
text: Keep your laptop in your hand luggage, never in checked baggage. Do not use public USB charging points. Use the VPN on hotel and airport Wi-Fi.

title: IT helpdesk hours and contacts
text: The IT helpdesk is available 24x7 on extension 4357, by email at helpdesk@kaverisystems.example, or through the service portal. Priority 1 incidents (a whole team cannot work) get a response within 15 minutes; standard requests within 8 business hours.
